timing_rule: Root active mathematical work tracked separately from agent time; overlapping agent time does not multiply elapsed theory credit. Pauses/cancellation supersede the minimum. No idle padding.
scope: Written theory, prior-result synthesis, focused primary-source search and synthetic mathematical checks; optional input-only feature geometry. No candidate fit, new challenge prediction, challenge-target access or upload.

assignments.rcerc: Corrected exact first-layer controls, one deployable design or scoped obstruction.
assignments.uniform: Uniform fixed-count suffix continuation, full estimator variance and setup cost.
assignments.current_shape: Continue current physical/Hermite/functional-shape path after T128; seek structural successor, not a direction or hyperparameter sweep.
assignments.root: DS/M and KCAS history/correction derivations, current-carrier compatibility, integration and adversarial comparison; output-aware compression if time useful.

deliverables: One root scratchpad with linked agent working notes
Zero to two frozen prospective candidates with lean next-test plan
Concise findings, limitations and actual root/agent timing
One-time trial assessment without permanent protocol changes
